council_map.vintage: Cannot tell. No ordinance, PDF or GIS layer found.
council_map.notes: Each council member's bio on the city page names the precincts of the district: D1 'Peru Precinct 02'; D2 'Peru Precincts 06, 07, and 09'; D3 'Peru Precinct 05'; D4 'Peru Precinct 03'; D5 'Washington Precinct 01' (raw/peru-in/members.html). Peru precincts 01, 04 and 08 are not named in any district and may be merged or renamed; a build from the state precinct layer needs the county precinct order to settle that. Searches found no ArcGIS layer (Miami County GIS is not public in results) and no redistricting ordinance; the city code is on amlegal (JS-gated, raw/peru-in/amlegal-ordlist.html is a challenge page).

notes: City website moved to cityofperu.in.gov; the older cityofperu.org copy lists the same mayor's office. A search summary pointed at perune.gov (Peru, Nebraska) - ignore. City court: state court directory (raw/peru-in/court-directory.pdf) lists a Peru City Court with a judge, 35 South Broadway; 2023 candidate list has a Peru City Judge candidate. Judge out of scope.
